- Tue 2026-12-01 13:00–15:00 PT

Thanks Mina — I’ll own run orchestration and evidence collection. Details from my side:

Run plan (canary-first):
- Pre-check (15m): confirm baseline cluster health, cache population, split traffic routing to canary nodes only
- Ramp (10m): 0% -> 100% of target (linear, 5% steps every 30s)
- Steady (30m): hold at target throughput
- Cooldown (5m): linear down

Observability we’ll capture during the run:
- Token-level telemetry (per-request token counts, latencies, model variant)
- GPU utilization & host-level metrics (nvidia-smi, loadavg)
- Inference engine logs (kv cache hit/miss rates)
- Traces for 1% sampled requests and all errors

Deliverable cadence: run results + acceptance_tally.xlsx posted to the Drive folder within 2 business hours of completion. If there’s an SLO breach we’ll include a short RCA within 24 hours.

I added a tentative Drive link with a minimal template: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-example-acceptance-artifacts

Action items for Acuity:
- Confirm prompt set (5–10 examples) by EOD Monday
- Approve Monday 11/30 09:00 PT slot or select the Tue 12/01 slot
